single_atom_prediction_from_lookup: call single_atom_prediction_from_lookup to get DFT reference energy predictions for single isolated atom systems
review_single_atom_prediction_from_looku: review single_atom_prediction_from_lookup to understand how it handles single atom systems without periodic boundary conditions
test_single_atom_prediction_from_lookup: test single_atom_prediction_from_lookup with a batch containing a single isolated atom and atom reference dictionary
